name: eps_tau
label: epsilon Tauri (Ain, K0 III red clump, Hyades)
sources: Anugu et al. 2026: radius 12.46 +/- 0.10 Rsun; Gaia DR3 parallax 22.3654 +/- 0.1721 mas -> 44.7 pc: theta_LD = 2R/d = 2.59 mas (no direct interferometric diameter found)
Baines et al. 2025: T_eff 4880 +/- 67 K; Teng et al. 2023: log g 2.66; Arentoft et al. 2019: mass 2.458 +/- 0.073 Msun
Sato et al. 2007: V 3.53, red-clump giant with a planet; 2MASS H 1.314, K 1.31
notes: A northern red-clump calibrator for the ISI (hd360 and hd17652 are the southern ones); first null 84 m at 900 nm, 61 m at 650 nm.
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets (V +0.02, H +1.39, K +1.85); 900 and 900 nm fall inside the anchored range.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. No NewEra model exists below 4700 K: blackbody + linear law.
